content: चेतन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [चित्-ल्यु] .²1 Animate, alive, living, sentient, feeling; चेतनाचेतनेषु <ls>Me. 5</ls> animate and inanimate. .²2 Visible, conspicuous, distinguished. .{@-नः@} .²1 A sentient being, a man. .²2 Soul, mind. .²3 The supreme soul. .²4 An animal in general. .{@-ना@} .²1 Sense, consciousness; चुलुकयति मदीयां चेतनां चञ्चरीकः <ls>R. G.</ls>; <ls>U. 3. 31</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9. 12</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 74</ls>; चेतनां प्रतिपद्यते regains oneʼs consciousness; .²2 Understanding, intelligence; पश्चिमाद्यामिनीयामात्प्रसादमिव चेतना <ls>R. 17. 1</ls>; … शास्ताखानोऽल्पचेतनः <ls>Śiva B. 29. 9</ls>. .²3 Life, vitality, animation; <ls>Bg. 13. 6</ls>. .²4 Wisdom, reflection. .{@-नम्@} Appearance. .²2 The thinking principle, the mind; अच्युतचेतनः <ls>Bhāg. 9. 15. 41</ls>.
